text:
Type: vine pattern throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: woven jacquard fabric with raised texture
Colors: ivory, black
Shape: square, vertical winding leafy vines with bold leaves, knife edges, compact
Feel: graphic, natural, fresh
Goes with: white or cream sofas, black accents, light wood, plants; Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Vine Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Black / Ivory
product.description: Made in USA and imported Black and white vine pattern in chenille yarns adds texture and brings a modern touch to your decor. Solid black back balances the pattern on the front. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. 17"L x 17"W Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove pillow from packaging and let it fully expand.
